_about: NOTAM 위치 서술 정답표. 파서를 보지 않고 원문만 읽어 작성했다. 이 스냅샷 전용이며 자료가 바뀌면 다시 만들어야 한다.

method.input: KML CDATA의 NOTAM 원문만. 파싱 결과(latest.json)는 쓰지 않았다.
method.rule: 좌표는 글자 그대로 복사. 도분초→소수 변환은 코드가 한다.

crossCheck.note: A0831/26은 장애물 PSN+RADIUS 표기 — point인지 circle인지 판단이 갈렸다.

psnRadius.note: CIRCLE 단어 없이 PSN+RADIUS로 원을 서술한다.

arcOrExclusion.note: 호·반원·제외구역(EXC)을 포함한다. 정확히 그릴 수 없으므로 넓게 덮는 쪽으로 처리한다.

coordinateIsNotPosition.note: VORTAC 사용불가 NOTAM. 본문의 유일한 좌표 3705N12701E는 대체 웨이포인트이지 이 NOTAM의 위치가 아니다. 좌표가 있다고 위치로 삼으면 안 되는 반례.

sourceDefect.note: 꼭짓점 하나가 중복되어 4각형이 3개 점으로 온다. 거의 동일한 E3284/26에는 네 번째 점(355433N1293008E)이 있다. 원본 자료의 결함이다.

duplicateAreas.note: 같은 다각형에 시간창만 다른 세 건. 정상이다.

items.evidence: 1. AREA : A CIRCLE RADIUS 2NM CENTERED ON 373523N1265832E
AREA : A CIRCLE RADIUS 1.5NM CENTERED ON 360243N1281333E
A SEMICIRCLE, 360118N1281017E - A CLOCKWISE 3NM ARC CENTERED ON 360243N1281333E-360408N1281649E TO THE BEGINNING EXC A CIRCLE RADIUS 1.5NM CENTERED ON 360243N1281333E FM SFC TO 9500FT MSL
items.note: not a plain circle: a semicircle bounded by a start point (360118N1281017E), a clockwise 3NM arc centered on 360243N1281333E, ending at 360408N1281649E, then a straight line back to start. Also carves out a smaller EXC circle (radius 1.5NM, same center, up to 9500FT MSL) matching D1842/26. Recorded shape=circle/radius=3NM for the dominant arc; treat with care.

vertex 355434N1292856E is repeated back-to-back in the source text (only 3 distinct points for a 4-cornered area); compare to the near-identical E3284/26 which has a 4th distinct vertex 355433N1293008E in that slot - likely a typo/dropped vertex in this NOTAM as issued.
same polygon as E3312/26 and E3314/26, different time window (D-schedule)
same polygon as E3312/26 and E3313/26, different time window (D-schedule)
FLOW CTL notice restricting a route (Y722/B576 via ATOTI); no area coordinates in E), applies to route/aerodrome operations not a bounded area
FLOW CTL notice restricting a route (A593 via SADLI); no area coordinates in E)
GPS unreliable/lost intermittently caution for whole Incheon FIR; no specific coordinates given in E)

E) is a VORTAC (navaid) unserviceability, not a self-contained area - closest to the 'none/belongs to facility' category. Text does give a coordinate, '3705N12701E', but it is offered as a substitute waypoint to use INSTEAD OF the out-of-service SOT VORTAC, not a stated position of the affected area itself, so it was not recorded as a coordTokens/evidence position per the 'do not guess' rule.

E) describes a conditional route (CDR2) as a table of named waypoint pairs and altitudes; no coordinates or named restricted/danger area given, so no area-shape can be assigned from the text. Marked 'none' as closest fit though it is not aerodrome-bound like typical 'none' cases.
